intent: Presentational standalone OnPush component rendering inline custom SVG icons by name. Public API exactly: IconComponent selector app-icon { name = input.required<IconName>(); size = input<number>(24) }. Imports IconName from shared/models/icon-name.model.ts. Provide SVG for heart, lungs, dumbbell, arrow-left, arrow-right, check; aria-hidden=true; stroke=currentColor.
